tests.name: DPIAwarenessValidation
messages_sanitized: Falha em processar o $QA_PACKAGE_ROOT\Citrica\Citrica.exe binário.
O app Emilians.Ctrica.UnsignedQA_1.7.0.0_x64__p9dw1q8pw0bz6 não tem Reconhecimento de DPI.

scope: Microsoft-signed local WACK against only the installed unsigned QA1.7 identity; same GUI/engines as final package. This is not Microsoft Store certification.
report_messages_redacted: Only user profile and QA package installation prefixes are replaced; names/results/requirements/warning and failure text are retained.

optional_blocked_executables.interpretation: The kit reports process-launch API references and blocked-name string matches in the GUI, bundled engines/libraries and documentation. This static result is informational for Desktop Bridge onboarding; it is not a log proving those matched strings were executed. Bundled engines are intentionally launched for offline conversions. S-mode compatibility is not asserted.

dpi.interpretation: Preserved as a real static finding: WACK could not process Citrica.exe and reports no DPI awareness. The exact executable manifest contains asInvoker and longPathAware, with no dpiAware/dpiAwareness element. This report does not reclassify the warning as PASS or a proven false positive. Actual Qt settings tests separately verified full visible bounds/buttons at effective process scales 1.0 and 1.5 while Windows DPI stayed 96; those tests do not establish OS per-monitor DPI behavior.

assessment.submission_gate: No required FAIL was reported. The remaining optional FAIL and required WARNING are retained for reviewer assessment; Microsoft Store certification remains a separate decision.
